name: Brother Anselm's letter
description: A single page in a gardener's careful hand, folded small and kept in the back of the Pell family Bible. Signed Anselm.
notes: mw-3n0f: the letter for The Name on the Bones (quest-name-on-the-bones) as a real item. Given by Hollis's dialogue (lent, or the thief's lift from the Bible; hollis.bible-lent and bones.letter-stolen still record which) and taken by Clatter when read to him (bones.letter-given). Quest item, nominal value, never sold.
